s: February 8, 2017 - Davin could be a unique amalgamation of the popular names David and Devin, but it also stands as an anglicized Irish surname from Ó Duibhín or Ó Daimhín. Meaning “little black one” from Ó Duibhín and “little stag” or “little ox” from Ó Daimhín, Davin celebrates baby’s rich, warm features and rambunctious wild side.
